name: reference_v2
description: Strict sequential motion blueprint: a repeating 8-beat camera cycle. Panel i uses segment (i mod 8) in order, so every cycle plays 1) Zoom In, 2) Pan Down, 3) Slide Right, 4) Zoom Out, 5) Pan Up, 6) Slide Left, 7) Zoom In, 8) Pan Down, then repeats continuously. Beat kinds are fixed by pan_kind_for_seg: static + zoom>=1.1 => zoom_in, static + zoom<=0.95 => zoom_out, dominant downward move => pan_down, dominant upward move => pan_up, dominant sideways move => pan_right / pan_left. The old 4-beat cycle only ever produced zoom/vertical pan, and the tall-panel path overrode even those, so every shot in a recap slid up or down.
